title: Skeletron Prime: saw, vice, cannon and laser as separately killable arms; spin doubles defense
player_outcome: Skeletron Prime fights as in Terraria: four independent arms (Saw 9000, Vice 9000, Cannon 7000, Laser 6000) that you can destroy one by one around a 28,000-life skull, which doubles its defense while spinning.
design: HandBrain styles, in a partial HandBrain.Styles.cs to stay under 400 lines:
saw: rapid short jabs toward the target within 6 m.
vice: slow approach, then a lunge-grab.
hold: stay at the anchor facing the target, letting the arm def's own 'ranged' fire.
prime_cannon has ranged prime_bomb; prime_laser has ranged death_laser.

Data mechs.json: skeletron_prime life 28000, defense 25, spinDefense +25. Parts: prime_saw [−3.2,−1.2,0.8], prime_vice [3.2,−1.2,0.8], prime_cannon [−3.6,−2.6,−0.4] mirror, prime_laser [3.6,−2.6,−0.4]. Keep armModel prime_arm_strut.
Remove segments, segmentModels and the ranged fromParts spec.
New enemies prime_saw, prime_vice, prime_cannon and prime_laser with Terraria life (9000/9000/7000/6000), damage (50/30/30/30), defense (38/34/23/20), using the existing prime_* models.
Delete the legacy segment-hand code paths in CryptWardenBrain and NpcRenderer.Arms now that no boss uses them.
data_changes: Prime restructured into a head plus four part enemies.
tests: Smoke mechs.cmds, after 'boss skeletron_prime 12': 'assert npcs.prime_saw == 1', 'assert npcs.prime_cannon == 1', 'slay prime_saw', 'assert boss.skeletron_prime.parts == 3', then the existing 'slay skeletron_prime' and flag asserts.
verification: dotnet test; headless mechs.cmds; boss gallery screenshot
risks: Four armed parts plus the head is five creatures, well within the NPC cap.
Arms that pass through walls in tight hardmode arenas: same Terraria trade-off as Skeletron.
